text: You see Amber, a teacher for the Followers.
source_text: You see Amber, a teacher for the Followers.

text: Now is when I rest. Please, come back during the evening.
source_text: Now is when I rest. Please, come back during the evening.

text: Welcome noble traveler. Have you come here to study?
source_text: Welcome noble traveler. Have you come here to study?

text: No. I really came here just to kill things.
source_text: No. I really came here just to kill things.

text: Depends on what you want to teach me.
source_text: Depends on what you want to teach me.

text: Yes, I am willing to learn.
source_text: Yes, I am willing to learn.

text: I am truly sorry to hear that. The Followers believe in peace at all costs. For that reason, I have renounced violence. Good evening.
source_text:
I am truly sorry to hear that. The Followers believe in peace at all
 costs. For that reason, I have renounced violence. Good evening.

text: I am skilled in many of the languages and arts. Perhaps you would like to learn one of those?
source_text:
I am skilled in many of the languages and arts. Perhaps you would like
 to learn one of those?

text: I'm sorry, but I need to know things which will help me survive.
source_text: I'm sorry, but I need to know things which will help me survive.

text: I have no time for that type of stuff. I'm gone.
source_text: I have no time for that type of stuff. I'm gone.

text: Perhaps I can listen to a song or two.
source_text: Perhaps I can listen to a song or two.

text: Can you teach me anything else?
source_text: Can you teach me anything else?

text: Ah, we have here a student of life. In a case like this, I can teach you some herbalism, but training takes a while for little result.
source_text:

text: Fine, just teach me.
source_text: Fine, just teach me.

text: Please, teach me what you can.
source_text: Please, teach me what you can.

text: Sorry, I really don't have time for plants. Goodbye.
source_text: Sorry, I really don't have time for plants. Goodbye.

text: You need not be rude. Apologize now, or I won't teach you.
source_text: You need not be rude. Apologize now, or I won't teach you.

text: I am sorry. Will you please teach me?
source_text: I am sorry. Will you please teach me?

text: Forget it.
source_text: Forget it.

text: That is better now. We will begin your studies.
source_text: That is better now. We will begin your studies.

text: You are an apt learner. May your trials be light. Go in peace.
source_text: You are an apt learner. May your trials be light. Go in peace.

text: As you see fit. May the future soften your heart and broaden your mind.

text: Very well, I will teach you the ways to survive.

text: You are an apt learner. May your trials be light. Go in peace.

text: You do not convince me. I think you seek to use my gifts for ill. Good evening.

You do not convince me. I think you seek to use my gifts for ill.
 Good evening.

text: Ah, a student of the arts is a rare thing in this world. Perhaps there is hope for you yet. Each song is long in time. Which would you like to hear?
source_text:

 is hope for you yet. Each song is long in time. Which would you like to hear?

text: In the Wake of the Shadow.
